walkthroughs.body_html:
Bacteria divide every ~20 minutes.

Random mutations create resistant individuals. Antibiotic kills the rest. Resistant bacteria reproduce — resistant population in days.

If 8 of 50 patients have MRSA, resistance rate = 8 ÷ 50 × 100 = 16%.

A rising % shows antibiotic effectiveness dropping.

Choose top 10% of cows for milk yield → breed. Daughter generation gives ~5% higher yield.

After 4 generations: (1.05)⁴ ≈ 1.22 = ~22% higher.

mcqs.q: How does a population of organisms become better adapted to its environment over time?
options: Organisms decide what features they need and grow them by force of will.
The enzyme has been completely broken into amino acids.
Individuals with advantageous heritable variations survive and reproduce more; their alleles increase in frequency over generations.
Individual organisms change during their lifetime in response to their environment and pass the changes on to offspring.

mcqs.q: During an action potential, do Na+ and K+ move through the same channels?
options: Organisms decide what features they need and grow them by force of will.
Only Na+ moves during an action potential; K+ stays still.
No — voltage-gated Na+ channels open first (depolarisation, Na+ in), then voltage-gated K+ channels open (repolarisation, K+ out).
Na+ and K+ swap places through the same channel at the same time.

mcqs.q: What happens to an enzyme when it is denatured?
options: The enzyme has been completely broken into amino acids.
Its tertiary structure (3D shape) changes, particularly the active site, so it can no longer bind substrate effectively.
The enzyme has died because enzymes are alive.
Only Na+ moves during an action potential; K+ stays still.
